from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs')

path=programs/'task-13fe1ca7.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hr = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    vc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r == hr or c == vc:
                out[r][c] = 3
                continue
            y = abs(r - hr)
            x = abs(c - vc)
            colored = (y % 2 == 0 and x <= y) or (x % 2 == 0 and x > y)
            out[r][c] = 4 if colored else 0
    return out
'''
